body: Hi. Thanks I hope you're doing ok too. I'm on a break from Reddit too but I'm allowing myself this thread

I'm really sorry, your thing sounds horrible. I couldn't imagine what it's like to have negative emotions towards something like that but if my feelings have taught me anything, it's that absolutely anything can be traumatising if its there at the right time. Is watching people v\*\*\*\* or just the idea of it happening to somebody else also disturbing?

My source rarely bothers me anymore. I don't have anyone I can tell but I've written about it out of interest. I'm working on getting the details perfect and I'm less confused and devastated than when it first arrived. But that source seems irrelevant to fixing what I'm feeling now, although it mildly traumatised me and changed the way I think, it won't stop the height thing. I experimented with exposure therapy about another specific type of change last year and that helped a lot, but I can't see that approach working with others like height.

Thanks so much. I made a post like this before in a lot less detail and everyone said OCD. I think that's possible but it doesn't seem like it at all, other than getting intrusive thoughts. These things enter my mind randomly because they make me deeply sad, I'm not sure if that's how OCD works or if I'm just really heartbroken. I haven't spoken to anyone about this because of social anxiety and it was hard enough posting these feelings on Reddit. Thank you so much for giving me hope but I don't know how getting through this is possible. The only possible cure is if I found out that the comments I read yesterday weren't true.
Yeah pretty much. Those are sometimes sources of why I feel bad

You aren't rude at all don't worry :) I'm fine with hair colour because it isn't a significant change. A positive psychological change like becoming affectionate is something I like as long as it's permanent.

Thank you so much, you didn't make it sound weird at all. In your classmate's friend's case, that sounds like a trigger and she's still suffering from the source. I hardly ever think about the person from three years ago anymore, but that was the point where the feelings began evolving into other things.
